task: A hypervisor uses one physical uplink for guest frames tagged with VLANs 10 and 20. Its separate management NIC is outside this task. Select the Layer 2 mode on the guest-facing switch port; native and allowed settings follow separately.

teaching.hint: Choose from the frames on this uplink, not from the number of physical servers.
teaching.takeaway: A trunk carries the two tagged guest VLANs. The host’s working management NIC proves nothing about this separate guest uplink, and the trunk does not provide inter-VLAN routing.
